nodes.label: Three-Layer Verification Strategy
nodes.rationale: Unit tests (runtests.jl) + Octave validation (validate-matlab.jl) + Golden regression tests. Hand-transcribed MATLAB layer removed due to transcription bugs.

nodes.label: Abstract Type Hierarchy (Documentation Scaffolding)
nodes.rationale: AbstractElement/AbstractSpring/AbstractTruss/AbstractBeam + @kwdef structs. NOT used by any function — documentation-only scaffolding (~120 lines). Kept as extension point.

nodes.label: Educational-First Design Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Textbook-correct implementations verified against Kattan MATLAB. Abstractions serve real use without over-engineering. Balance teaching clarity with practical utility.

nodes.label: Plots.jl Weak Dependency via Julia Extensions
nodes.rationale: Diagram functions moved to ext/LibFEMPlotsExt.jl via Julia extension (auto-activates when both LibFEM and Plots loaded). Core math works without Plots. Implemented 2026-07.
nodes.norm_label: plots.jl weak dependency via julia extensions

nodes.label: A > 0 Validation Everywhere
nodes.rationale: Negative A creates unphysical stiffness. Enforce A>0 in all truss/frame functions, consistent with existing L>0 validation.
